rules.title: How to play
rules.intro: Everyone gets a secret word. Most players share the same word, but the infiltrators have a similar word, or none at all. Describe your word without saying it, find the infiltrators and vote them out.
rules.roles.title: Roles
rules.roles.000_CIVILIAN: Gets the main word. Wins by voting out every Undercover and Mr. White.
rules.roles.100_UNDERCOVER: Gets a similar but different word and does not know it. Wins by staying alive.
rules.roles.200_MR_WHITE: Gets no word. Wins by staying alive, or by guessing the Civilians' word when voted out.
rules.round.title: A round
rules.round.1: Describe: in the order shown, each player says one word or short phrase about their word. Never say the word itself.
rules.round.2: Discuss: who sounds like they have a different word?
rules.round.3: Vote: point at one player together. That player is out and their role is revealed.
rules.round.4: If Mr. White is voted out, they get one guess at the Civilians' word. A right guess wins the game for Mr. White alone.
rules.win.title: Winning
rules.win.civilians: Civilians win when every Undercover and Mr. White is out.
rules.win.infiltrators: Infiltrators win when only one Civilian is left alive.
rules.win.mrWhite: Mr. White wins alone by guessing the Civilians' word.
rules.score.title: Points
rules.score.body: Civilian 3, Mr. White 7, Undercover 9. Every member of the winning side scores. If Mr. White guesses right, only Mr. White scores.
rules.tips.title: Tips
rules.tips.1: Be vague enough to hide a similar word, but specific enough to prove you have the right one.
rules.tips.2: Mr. White: listen to the others and blend in.
rules.tips.3: On a tie, vote again or describe once more, then decide together.
